civic_virtuoso_desc: The Yaderans possess a rare artistic talent and an instinctive understanding of the subtle intricacies of matter and energy. Their expertise in holographic technology is unparalleled in the galaxy.
civic_warp_capable_desc: This society has achieved warp flight, but is focused on life on its own homeworld, with little interest in expanding out amongst the stars.
civic_warrior_kahless_desc: 'Kahless left us, all of us, a powerful legacy. A way of thinking and acting that makes us Klingon.' - Emperor Kahless (Clone)
civic_way_of_the_gun_desc: The Way of the Gun is an old western term meaning that the person with the gun makes the law.
civic_xeno_vultures_desc: This society adds to their population by reanimating the deceased corpses of other species, altering their DNA to transform them into one of their own.
councilor_bajoran_kai_desc: The $TITLE$ is the religious leader of the Bajorans, elected from among and by the Vedek Assembly to a life term. Leader must have the Kai trait.
councilor_borg_defense_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the defense and assimilation directives across the Collective.
councilor_borg_done_desc: The $TITLE$ coordinates the drone activity within the hive mind.
councilor_borg_scientist_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the research directives across the Collective.
councilor_borg_unity: Primary Adjunct of Unimatrix Zero One
councilor_borg_unity_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the unity and disseminates the queens will throughout the collective.
councilor_chief_ambassador_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for working with the ambassadorial service to promote trust from other empires. Requires leader with the Ambassador Trait.
councilor_chief_medical_2_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the health and wellbeing of the population. Requires a leader with Consultant or CMO trait.
councilor_chief_medical_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the health and wellbeing of the population. Requires a leader with Consultant or CMO trait.
councilor_cloner_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for cloning operations.
councilor_ferengi_fca_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible with overseeing business practices and the enforcement of Ferengi Trade By-Laws.
councilor_high_priest_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the religious well-being of this empire. Must be a believer with a spiritualist ethic.
councilor_hirogen_hunter_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for hunts across Hirogen space, all new rules start and end with the Master of the Hunt.
councilor_klingon_brigadier_desc: A brigadier is a high ranking official who can handle the position of military advisor to the Chancellor, and can speak on behalf of the High Command.
councilor_master_genesist_desc: The $TITLE$ is responsible for the advancement of Eugenics.
councilor_obsidian_order_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees all actions of the Obsidian Order. Requires the Obsidian Order trait
councilor_orion_syndicate_desc: The $TITLE$ is a position that doesn't officially exist, unofficially they coordinate syndicate activities within the Empire. The leader must have one of the Syndicate tags or be Corrupt.
councilor_ruler_borg_desc: I am the beginning, the end, the one who is many. I am the Borg.
councilor_ruler_dominion_desc: The drop becomes the ocean... The ocean becomes a drop.
councilor_ruler_klingon_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees the Klingon Empire and the Great and Noble Klingon Houses.
councilor_starfleet_security_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees all security actions involved in the protection of Starfleet. Requires a leader with either the section 31 or security agents/officer trait.
councilor_tal_shiar_desc: The $TITLE$ oversees all Tal Shiar Operations on behalf of the Empire. Requires the Tal Shiar or Zhat Vash trait.
councilor_temporal_scientist_desc: The individual holding $TITLE$ role is responsible for the advancement of Temporal studies within the Empire.
councilor_war_desc: The $TITLE$ is in charge of military administration and all matters of war.
counter_espionage_1_desc: Minimal security checks on our populace.
counter_espionage_2_desc: Moderate security checks on our populace, balancing disrupting lives with internal security.
counter_espionage_3_desc: Maximum security checks on our populace, offering the most protection but also disrupting lives.
crossbreeding_allowed_desc: No restrictions imposed by the government on breeding rights.
crossbreeding_not_allowed_desc: Different species may not breed with each other, preventing the creation of half-species.
dominion_espionage_1_desc: Minimal funding for the security agency.
dominion_espionage_2_desc: Moderate funding for the security agency..
dominion_espionage_3_desc: Max funding for the security agency..
dominion_member_terms_desc: Force all subjects to comply with the terms of Dominion Membership and to pay fealty to the Founders.
drone_de_assimilation_1_desc: Drones will be de-assimilated where possible, and deactivated where necessary. Low risk of hostile re-activation.
drone_de_assimilation_2_desc: Drones will be de-assimilated. Moderate risk of hostile re-activation.
drone_deactivation_desc: Drones will be deactivated and destroyed over a period of time. Minimal risk of hostile re-activation.
edict_edict_advanced_spy_network_desc: Our espionage departments work tirelessly to give our forces a vital edge on the galactic scene, by giving them the additional resources they crave boosts their potential.
edict_edict_anti_borg_adaptation_desc: Increases the chance that our ships will successfully remodulate their weapons when the Borg attempt to adapt against them.
edict_edict_anti_borg_analysis_desc: Significantly reduces the time required for our ships to remodulate their weapons if the Borg manage to adapt against them.
edict_edict_anti_borg_assimilation_desc: Greatly reduces the ability of Borg drones to invade and assimilate our vessels.
edict_edict_architectural_renaissance_de: Massive investments in architecture ensure that all our planetary building construction projects and megastructures receive the most attention, improving the speeds at which they are built.
edict_edict_borg_defensive_ship_building: Increases ship construction speed for a short period of time.
edict_edict_borg_mass_assimilation_desc: Reduces passive £ Unity production to enable assimilation of additional pops per month.
edict_edict_capacity_overload_borg_desc: Additional processing power will be redirected to power processing and gathering, ensuring optimal energy production.
edict_edict_capacity_overload_desc: Allows short-term overloading of regional grids, letting local power plants run at increased capacity.
edict_edict_capacity_overload_machine_de: Additional processing power will be redirected to power processing and gathering, ensuring optimal energy production.
edict_edict_conscription_campaign_desc: Puts into place a national draft where personnel with the skills to become crew members are pressed into active service.
edict_edict_counter_esp_1_desc: Provides a boost to our tireless security services attempting to keep us safe from foreign agents.
edict_edict_counter_esp_2_desc: Ensures that our espionage services actively attempt to prevent threats to our security by actively deploying anti espionage and counterintelligence plans.
edict_edict_counter_esp_3_desc: Apply tight internal security and counterintelligence methods to ensure that our security is given top priority.
edict_edict_counter_esp_4_desc: Operate a security state to prevent information getting into the wrong hands, civil liberties take a backseat to ensuring we maintain our internal security.
edict_edict_declare_saint_desc: Public edicts encourage our people to pick up the old religious texts again and join together with the unity that can only be found in the spiritual world, bringing our people closer together.
edict_edict_defensive_ship_building_desc: When defending our empire from an aggressive force all efforts should be put into defending our borders.
edict_edict_desperate_measures_desc: Will give us direct control over key industries and factories. Our military will want for nothing as we guide the materials and workforce to our war industry.
edict_edict_diplomatic_grants_desc: This encourages collaborations which allow different cultures from around the galaxy to come together to share their ideas and experiences, ensuring a rich cultural collaboration and improving the happiness of other species.
edict_edict_dominion_shipbuilding_desc: The mighty shipyards of the Dominion can be put in overdrive thanks to the motivated efforts of the loyal Jem'Hadar.
edict_edict_early_warning_desc: Sets up small sensor buoys across the system to increase the sensor range of this system to give early warning of enemy fleets.
edict_edict_early_warning_machine_desc: This protocol sets up small sensor buoys across the system to increase the sensor range of this system to give early warning of enemy fleets.
edict_edict_education_campaign_desc: Reforms to our educational policies ensure that our best and brightest rise to the top leadership positions.
edict_edict_education_campaign_machine_d: Supporting the most effective drones with improved processing priority and supplies allows those drones to adapt more rapidly.
edict_edict_encourage_free_thought_desc: Encourages the populace to always challenge conventional wisdom, even if the path taken may lead them astray.
edict_edict_farming_subsidies_desc: Provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.
edict_edict_farming_subsidies_nomad_desc: Provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.
edict_edict_fc_union_desc: The galaxy is full of potential first contact scenarios, by dedicating effort in our diplomatic teams we boost our chances.
edict_edict_feed_the_fire_desc: Our efforts to tame the impure require increased resource production. Increased food production will fuel increase ship building speed.
edict_edict_fleet_focus_desc: Whether its to explore new worlds or subdue our enemies, this edict puts our fleets wellbeing front and centre.
edict_edict_fortress_proclamation_desc: A large investment towards improving and upgrading our defensive starbases across the galaxy.
edict_edict_fortress_proclamation_machin: A large investment towards improving and upgrading our defensive starbases across the galaxy.
edict_edict_grand_fleet_desc: Puts the pride and glory of the Empire's Grand Fleet above all else, and that considerable political capital should be spent ensuring its continued prosperity.
edict_edict_healthcare_campaign_desc: Reforms across our healthcare platforms ensures our population is healthy and fruitful.
edict_edict_information_quarantine_desc: Puts strict checks on the flow of information, better preserving local cultural identities.
edict_edict_land_of_opportunity_desc: Creates targeted PR campaigns that frame the planet as being on the cutting edge, a new social frontier - a place where anyone can thrive and make a fresh start.
edict_edict_local_festival_1_desc: First Contact Day is the celebration of the iconic first contact between warp pioneer Zefram Cochrane and the Vulcan ship the T'Plana-Hath. It is one of the defining moments in Human history, eventually paving the way for a unified world government.
edict_edict_local_festival_2_desc: Kot'baval is a great annual celebration, marking the glorious victory of Kahless the Unforgettable's glorious victory over the evil Molor in single combat. It is customary for warriors from all over the Empire to take part in the reenactment of this glorious battle.
edict_edict_local_festival_3_desc: Kal Rekk is a day of atonement, solitude and silence, celebrating key and important values of Vulcan Philosophy.
edict_edict_local_festival_4_desc: The Peldor Gratitude Festival is an important event for our people, dating back as far as 17600 BCE. The smell of burning Bateret leaves will fill the streets of every Bajoran planet, worries and troubles will be burnt away through the burning of renewal scrolls. Peldor joi!
edict_edict_local_festival_5_desc: Prixin is a time for family. Lasting multiple days, our Prixin Celebration is a joyful and happy time. We gather on these day to extol the warmth and joy of those unshakable bonds. Without them we could not call ourselves complete. On this day we are thankful to be together.
edict_edict_local_festival_6_desc: Eitreih'hveinn is the honoring of domestic produce. On this day, only priest-sanctioned food can be eaten.
edict_edict_local_festival_7_desc: In order to distract our population from the woes of everyday life, this edict will provide plentiful food and spectacles to keep the population entertained.
edict_edict_local_festival_8_desc: Mother's Day is a celebration honoring the mother of the family, as well as motherhood, maternal bonds, and the influence of mothers in society.
edict_edict_local_festival_9_desc: A tradition going back to the foundation of the Confederation, whereby a grand ceremony is held to celebrate the execution of dissidents, alien sympathizers, and terrorists.
edict_edict_map_the_stars_desc: Pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_borg_desc: The activation of this protocol diverts the Collectives £ Unity resources towards the production of additional drones.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_desc: Noting the need for additional officers, allows for the fast tracking of more officers via our academies.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_machine_de: Activating this subroutine promotes the creaton of more units capable of crewing our vessels.
edict_edict_officer_subsidies_undine_des: Focusing our efforts on increasing the rate at which we spawn our leaders results in an increase in officer production.
edict_edict_peace_festivals_desc: A festival to celebrate and show our species' history and culture, creating joy and happiness to all involved.
edict_edict_production_targets_atypical_: The focused attention of the entire world will be dedicated to productivity.
edict_edict_production_targets_borg_desc: Additional processing power will be redirected to mineral processing and refinement procedures, ensuring optimal ore production.
edict_edict_production_targets_desc: Focuses our administrative effort to reprioritise and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.
edict_edict_production_targets_machine_d: Additional processing power will be redirected to mineral processing and refinement procedures, ensuring optimal ore production.
edict_edict_production_targets_und_desc: Focuses our administrative effort to reprioritise and re-evaluate production goals, boosting our production means.
edict_edict_push_ufp_formation: Form the United Federation of Planets
edict_edict_push_ufp_formation_desc: A dream that became a reality and spread throughout the stars.
edict_edict_recovery_protocols_borg_2_de: The collective has been damaged, revert primary operations to restoring control.
edict_edict_recovery_protocols_borg_desc: The collective has been damaged, revert primary operations to restoring control.
edict_edict_recycling_campaign_desc: Mass recycling and ecological awareness campaigns are undertaken to ensure our population is mindful of what they consume and waste, leading to a reduction in consumer good consumption.
edict_edict_recycling_campaign_machine_d: Large-scale repair programmes are put underway to ensure drones are operating at peak efficiency and older more inefficient drones are retired. This will reduce the impact on goods required to ensure optimal circumstances.
edict_edict_research_focus_2_desc: We provide subsidies and incentives for students undertaking core science, engineering and mathematical classes to provide the core technologies that a burgeoning interstellar race requires.
edict_edict_research_focus_desc: Allows discounts for students studying science, technology, engineering or mathematics, the most important courses of a space civilisation.
edict_edict_research_footing_desc: Will give improved control over our research branches. Our scientists will be provided with a large support staff and high quality equipment.
edict_edict_share_burden_campaign_desc: Enforces rotating tasks and work schedules for indentured servants, as more varied drudgery can lead to an uptick in productivity.
edict_edict_spy_counter_borg_desc: Establishes internal security subroutines and counter measures to ensure the collectives cyber defenses remain unbreached.
edict_edict_spy_counter_undine_desc: The impure must not get hold of our secrets, locking this knowledge down is the only means of keeping it safe.
edict_edict_spy_network_borg_desc: Activating this protocol will boost the collectives abilities to infiltrate the collectives targets computer systems.
edict_edict_spy_network_desc: The art of espionage is as old as the first civilisations on our homeworld. Increasing our efforts to uncover the secrets of our neighbours will only benefit us.
edict_edict_the_weak_shall_perish_desc: The time has come to drive out the impure and dominate the galaxy. The weak shall perish and the strong shall triumph.
edict_edict_ufp_union_desc: The galaxy is full of potential first contact scenarios, by dedicating effort in our diplomatic teams we boost our chances.
edict_edict_undine_conscription_campaign: Puts into place a national draft where personnel with the skills to become crew members are called to answer the call of the Fluidic Space.
edict_edict_undine_research_focus_desc: Will give improved control over our research branches. Our scientists will be provided with a large support staff and high quality equipment.
edict_edict_undine_vanguard_desc: Set in motion a chain of events that will set the Undine Vanguard loose onto the galaxy.
edict_edict_war_drone_campaign_desc: Puts into place a national service programme where our civilians learn the basics of a disciplined and military life, thus ensuring high standards in our armies.
edict_edict_war_drone_campaign_machine_d: This protocol allows planetary combat drones to take priority over normal processing capacity, improving their adaptability.
edict_edict_war_undine_campaign_desc: Puts into place a drive to build up our armies and fleets to support our war efforts.
edict_edict_will_to_power_desc: We must capture the hearts and minds of our people. Our policies can be adapted to give the people what they think they want.
edict_edict_zhat_vash_desc: Shows active support for the secret organisation, the Zhat Vash, and their mission. Activating the edict will allow additional support and opportunities for this organisation.
edict_push_ufp_formation_effect: Push the formation of the United Federation of Planets, should you have previously decided against forming the UFP or wish to speed up the process.
edict_undine_vanguard_effect: Trigger the events that kick start the Undine invasion of the Milky Way.
espionage_1_desc: Minimal funding for our intelligence agency.
espionage_2_desc: Moderate funding for our intelligence agency.
espionage_3_desc: Maximum funding for our intelligence agency.
gender_rights_equality_desc: Gender equality, also known as sexual equality, is the state of equal ease of access to resources and opportunities, including economic participation and decision-making, and the state of valuing different behaviors, aspirations and needs equally, regardless of gender.
gender_rights_misandry_desc: Within certain societies, the female of the species is the sole decision maker for the species as the males are considered lesser beings due to perceived failures.
gender_rights_misogyny_desc: Female Oppression often takes place in male dominated societies due to females being perceived as weaker or as commodities to be traded.
gov_aca_sovereignty_desc: After centuries of old feuds and devastating wars, most of the Acamarian clans have come together in the realization that despite their internal grievances, they need a unified that will represent the world in all its interstellar dealings. The federal government holds little power, with checks and balances keeping most of the power in the hands of the Ruling Council - which grants seats to every recognized clan in the world. The Sovereign, the nominal head of the federal government, is elected by direct popular vote.
gov_agency_desc: Agencies are extensions of a parent government tasked with fulfilling a specific function.
gov_ate_shoalassembly_desc: The aquatic nature of the Antedean people results in natural migration patterns that remain to this day. The citizens tend to flock together in large, dynamic shoals. Whilst individual shoals have their own leader, a representative is elected from the shoal leaders to assume a leadership position as Pathfinder to lead the Antedeans into the vast ocean of space. The highly intricate and convoluted society of the Antedeans is generally optimistic, transparent and positive, but it also harbors many dark currents.
gov_barzan_republic_desc: Governed by a Premier, the Barzan Planetary Republic is a made up of a collection of memberstates that elect representatives to manage their world on a galactic scale.
gov_borg_collective_desc: The Borg Collective is an intelligent, ruthless hive mind comprised of billions of assimilated drones linked together via cybernetic implants. Every trace of identity or individuality within the Collective is suppressed, giving it tremendous efficiency in analysis, adaptation, and coordinated action. It is driven by a singular will to conquer and assimilate any species that might advance its evolution, without regard for opposition, diplomacy, or ensuing loss of life.
gov_borg_cooperative_desc: The Cooperative retains many of the augments and communication devices and infrastructure of the former Collective, which allows the ex-drones to still create a highly capable and responsive direct democracy. While this form of government can be myriad in indecision, the Cooperative has clear guidelines that allow local leaders to act when needed, often ceasing a great deal of temporal power. While there is certainly an enormous potential for future abuse, so far, the Cooperative functions well, as every ex-drone remembers the horror of their lack of individuality, and will never dream of limiting the freedom of their compatriots.
gov_borg_cyborg_desc: In millennia past, there have been numerous Holy Empires where the Leader was worshipped as an infallible living god. When that Leader is an eternal, mechanical being of great intellect, however, something truly different emerges. The Leader represents everything the Collective ever aspired to be but never succeeded, and it is the centre of every facet of the new Empire. With its great computational speed and full, remote access to every ex-drone, the Leader is also capable of making almost every decision in the Empire.
gov_borg_unimatrix_desc: In the dream, everyone is equal. Once Unimatrix Zero became a reality, the former dreamers sought to preserve this equality in their new utopia. The Commune is firmly guided by moralistic principles, solidarity and non-violence. Almost all decisions are decided on the local level by a direct democratic vote, with very few powers vested in the global, representative government that guides and protects the Unimatrix denizens as a whole.
gov_circle_matrons_desc: Skrreean society deems that men are too emotional to be effective leaders, and as such are relegated to a subservient position. The Circle of Matrons, some of the most prominent women on the planet, ensure that female led superiority cannot be threatened and works to actively promote the superiority of Skrreean culture.
gov_commission_desc: This government is a form of oligarchy that is rabidly obsessed with genetic research and superiority. While they do not see their own species as superior to other lifeforms in the galaxy, they are entirely assured that a significant minority of their own population, due to gender, ethnicity, nationality or phenotype, is inferior. The entire government is built around the preservation of those ingrained notions and divisions between superiors and inferior members of society.
gov_constitutional_empire_desc: After a long, graceful transition from a militant planetary empire to a space-bound constitutional monarchy, the emperor of the Andorian Empire chooses to die heirless and divest all power to the Parliament. Centuries later, the Empire is now a pure representative democracy in all but name. The Empty Throne still resides in a chamber of Parliament Hall and acts as the figurative head of state, while the Chancellor rules the Empire.
gov_curator_council_desc: The Curator Council was once but a small, if highly respected, arm of the Hur'Q Domain government. The Council was a loose body that represented the leaders, fleet admirals and ship captains of the great Museums of Hur'Q - vast, floating, nomadic ships that harvested, scavenged, curated and displayed biological beings and technological advances from across the galaxy. After the fall of the Domain and the Purge, the only Hur'Q left alive in the galaxy were the few museum Curators that had the wisdom to flee to the corners of the galaxy. Over centuries, those fleets slowly returned, establishing a new government, a council of the most powerful, ruthless and cunning Curator-War-Captains.
gov_darsay_converts_desc: Under the light of the Waxing Cycle and the rule of the God Emperor are stretched the Kingdoms of D'Arsay, as numerous as the stars in the sky. The D'Arsay Federal government, composed of the Emperor themselves and the advisory Council of Clans, holds in theory ultimate power. In practice, however, the D'Arsay people retain much of their original, ancient and proud civilisation. The D'Arsay culture grew in the time of peace, many millennia ago, that brought about the slow unification of many small kingdoms, villages and tribes. All of them now share a common elite culture, rich in iconography, architecture and mythology, but most still have their own heritage, language and currency.
gov_deliberative_democracy_desc: Cherishing diversity of opinions as well as a good argument, the Tellarite government is a pure reflection of the species - bewildering, conflicting and yet strangely effective. Unlike most representative democracies, the Technocracy does not have an executive body or base its decision making on majority votes. Instead, the elected governors meet in the grand forum every day to debate policy, enacting new rules and resolutions only when they reach sufficient consensus.
gov_detapa_council_desc: The Detapa Civilian Council of the Cardassian Union started as a nominally democratic executive body, in theory in direct control over the Cardassian Central Command and the Obsidian Order. In time, however, the dividing line between the civil administration and the military blurred, then disappeared. The eleven members of the Council are selected by a democratic vote, but they are still nothing more than puppets in a vast military machine.
gov_elder_council_desc: The Kelpien government is a unique combination of a fully egalitarian society where every member of the herd is equal, elder worship and ancient feudal roots. The Kelpien never had a war between them, but their original roots stem in local, nomadic herds that clung together for protection. Millennia ago, those small kingdoms/herds, or duchies as they become known, swore allegiance to the ancient Empire - ruled by a small collection of Kelpien that were brave and skilled enough to protect the other duchies from predators. In time, the Empire became a free union where each duchy is represented by an Elder Kelpien with senses developed to an almost mystical ability. Nowadays, the Elders are selected by popular vote, but they are still, more often than naught, true Elders.
gov_federal_republic_desc: A warp-age Federal Republic is an interstellar union of semi-autonomous states that agree to exist under a single central government and are governed by a unified constitution that ensures universal rights, liberty and equality. The federal government is responsible for all diplomatic interactions with external powers as well as the coordination and creation of a mutual defensive fleet, although many states still operate their own local law forces, militias and navies.
gov_ferengi_board_desc: The Ferengi Alliance is a unique and highly unstructured government, which promotes a mostly unregulated laissez-faire economy coupled with a highly democratic constitution that grants every citizen - or at least every male citizen - equal opportunities under the Bill of Opportunities. The Alliance is ultimately ruled by a Grand Nagus that may appoint his own successor, but the Nagus is limited by the Board of Liquidators of the Ferengi Commerce Association and the fact he holds very little actual authority.
gov_gorn_hegemony_desc: The Gorn Hegemony has a unique political structure, that has evolved over centuries. The main ruling body is the Assembly, including delegates from every major continent, city, planet, and station. Those delegates are not chosen directly by the population but instead rose to their position by merit of their success and achievements. Every 20 years, the assembly elects an Imperator, which serves as the head of the Gorn Space Command and serves as chairman to the Assembly. While an Imperator nominally has the power to overrule the Assembly in matters of state and defense, to do so exposes them to great risk - since in the highly meritocratic society of the Gorn, if they fail, they will be removed from office.
gov_great_house_desc: A Great House is led by the household 'Epetai' and has a great deal of autonomy.
gov_great_link_desc: There are no words to describe the Great Link, the heart and soul of the Dominion. It is not a single entity. The governmental edifice that has slowly accrued around it, to manage the business of the lesser species that make up the Dominion, is no less convoluted. Yet, despite it all, the Link prevails, and even thrives.
gov_hazari_mercs_desc: Governed by the most powerful Mercenary Groups, who come together to dictate how the Hazari society evolves and what life looks like for those under the iron grip of the powerful orders.
gov_high_command_desc: The Vulcan High Command is the most powerful governmental body on Vulcan and its de facto military government. The High Command is responsible for overseeing Vulcan military and civilian organisations, as well as Vulcan's space fleet, diplomatic missions, and scientific research.
gov_high_council_desc: Ever since the death of Kahless, the Klingon Empire has been ruled by the High Council - a militaristic and feudal form of oligarchy, steeped in tradition and honor. Sometimes named the Klingon High Command, all decisions concerning the state are taken by the Chancellor. He rules by the will of the Council, representing 24 of the great houses in the Empire.
gov_holy_order_desc: The spiritualistic dictatorial government of the Holy Order of the Kinshaya is all-encompassing and has command over every facet of a Kinshaya's life. Religion, military and culture are all one under the Holy Order.
gov_isu_desc: Multiplanetary Unions represent a number of different worlds and species under a single state, itself comprised of semi-autonomous sectors.
gov_isu_sector_desc: Interstellar Union sectors enjoy broad autonomy to conduct their private affairs, but they are still subject to the principles of the Union Charter.
gov_karemman_foundation_desc: Founded by wealthy merchants known for their fairness and cautious business practices, the highly ritualistic and orderly Karemma are led by an elected First Minister.
gov_kazon_sects_desc: True to its name, the government of the Kazon Sects is not really a true government at all. Many of the sects openly fight with each other, and only under a strong Maje can the infighting be temporarily halted and each sect pointed in the correct direction. The Kazon Sects were once united under Jal Sankur when they escaped from slavery by the Trabe, but quickly descended into infighting. A common enemy can bring the Sects together, or they may shatter.
gov_khanate_desc:
True to its name, the Augments Khanate government is not that dissimilar from the ancient Khanate of which its draws its name from. Both then, and now, the Khanate has been mistaken to be nothing more than a squabbling group of powerful warlords under the command of a single Great Khan, king of kings, with power being held only by those that seize it.

In truth, the Augments respect strength and genetic purity but also order and logic. The Great Khan is elected in a democratic vote by all the different Khans, and while the Great Khan can designate a heir, any Khan may challenge that by calling a moot - and voting to replace the new Great Khan.
gov_kobali_democracy_desc: The Kobali unique reproduction method required them to reinvent their government as well - finding an uneasy balance that both respects true equality to all members of society, as well as protection for the cultural remnants that various assimilated members bring with them from their own cultures and species. The result is somewhat similar to the ancient Athenian democracy, where certain government positions are reserved to members of xeno-minorities. While during any vote that encompass the entire population all citizens have equal say, in many local matters those 'dead-speakers' have additional weight, responsibilities, and power.
gov_krenim_imperium_desc: The Krenim Imperium government is an odd mixture of enlightened technocratic principles with a highly militaristic autocracy. All citizens are expected to serve in the military, but that establishment is remarkably open to supporting and financing works of art and scientific research. Many military commanders are also artists or scientists. From this unique attitude the Temporal Defense Agency sprung forth, benefitting from complete access to both a roster of creative, motivated scientists and the vast funds reserved to military applications. The Agency is now the largest department of the Imperium, in charge of creating a stable and prosperous future of the Imperium.
gov_lurian_court_desc:
While nominally in control of the Lurian Principality, the royal family of Luria has only taken control of the planet in 2071, when the royal navy took over the capital city-state of Tinvaal. With the integration of Tinvaal, the royal family has adopted what is considered the oldest democratic institution still in existence - the three courts.

The courts, while relegated to a purely advisory role, still wield a great deal of financial power and serve to keep the royal family in check. Only the courts may raise taxes, authorize the annual budget or declare war.

The tricameral courts contain the Keepers of Lur, who are indirectly elected from the entire populace, the Keepers of Law, who are directly elected in each province and the Keeper of Keys, who include unelected representatives of every governmental institution as well as the other two courts. All legislation must be approved by all houses but also by the royal family.
gov_maritime_sovereignty_desc: The rules of the high sea where the commander of each ship is the lord of all that they command. The ruling family governs the maritime council since the first time the Monean's left their old world in search of a new way of life.
gov_medical_directorate_desc: This Vidiian Sodality is nominally a representative democracy with an elected civilian body. In practice, the Sodality is a brutal, materialistic and highly specific form of oligarchy. The entire governmental apparatus deals with the pursuit of a cure to the Phage and the procurement of replacement organs, at the cost of everything else. Those agencies are under the control of an advisory of committee of medical practitioners and biological researchers that holds a huge amount of power, and de facto rules the Sodality.
gov_ministry_elder_desc: The Voth Ministry of Elders watches over the many Circles of Voth society, ensuring that Doctrine, the ancient tales that tell of Voth supremacy and divine right over the galaxy, is adhered to. Any threats to Doctrine are dealt with quickly, and robustly, which does stifle development but ensures the way of life of the Elders is not threatened.
gov_orion_freestates_desc:
In the early 21st century, under the political pressure of the legendary High Prince Abbran-Tadji, the various squabbling and plotting trade princes and free states of the Orion people came together. Abbran-Tadji was the then head of the criminal Orion Syndicate, the only body powerful enough to bend the other princes to his will. Still, the Union survived Abbran-Tadji assassination, and became the most important political body in what was once known as the Orion Free States, and before that, the Glorious Orionic Empire.

Originally, the Trade Union served as an internal arbitration body and solved all internal disputes between the Orion's mercantile houses. Since then, it has also granted authority to dictate foreign and military policy, while every planet and house retains its independence.

The Union has representatives from every house and city-state. Together, the Union also select a High Prince, or 'Ala Shodar', to serve as chairman for a limited time.
gov_psionic_consensus_desc: Many minds meet together and form one, allowing for a mutual decision that every member takes part in.
gov_psionic_democracy_desc: The Talosian Remnant is all that is left of the once planet spanning civilisation that covered Talos. Surviving underground away from the aftermath of their war, they use their psionic powers to create wonderful and magnificent artificial habitats for themselves.
gov_qomar_dignitatum_desc: Led by the ruling Prelate a council of the top Mathematicians and theologists within the Planetary Alliance determine who is worthy of the Qomarians time.
gov_romulan_senate_desc: The Romulan Star Empire has endured for two thousand years, and in that time it has hardly changed, with new governmental organizations and structures layering one atop another. The public face of the government is the Senate, with senators selected as long-term representatives of their provinces. There are no term limits to a Romulan senator and thus they can spend decades squabbling over position and power. The truly powerful ones maneuver themselves into a seat on the shadowy continuing committee, that has the power to derail the career of any senator and even to select the next Praetor.
gov_ruling_conclave_desc: The Tholians maintain that their form of government is the highest level of democracy found in the galaxy. All local matters are decided by a local forum, or Lattice, representing all local Tholians in a direct democracy. Members of each Lattice also choose Magistrates, that make decisions in case of emergencies or deal with all external matters. Tholian ship captains are chosen by their peers, in a similar fashion. The Tholian Assembly is ruled by several organizations made by volunteering Magistrates, that are chosen for life to serve in their new post by virtue of merit and performance. The highest organization is the Ruling Conclave, that has little executive power but holds the entire knowledge of every Lattice in the Assembly.
gov_saurian_league_desc: Spurred by early contact with other space-faring trading species, the Saurian's various nation states quickly banded together for better distribution of commercial rights and access to Sauria's few working spaceports. The result was the Global League, a much more grand name than it was deserving, considering it did not even represent all the nation states. Still, it was the first step into what would become a truly unified and global Federal Republic.
gov_sheliak_corporate_desc: The Sheliak Corporate is a misnomer - it is neither a proper interstellar government nor a capitalist conglomerate. The silicon-based species cares very little for material wealth, but instead value precision and efficiency. The Corporate was established by several academic concerns on Shelia for the sole purpose of dictating all regulation involved with interstellar affairs, including colonization, commerce and diplomacy. While the Corporate is not in charge of enforcement or execution, the strict adherence of all Sheliak to the scripture of the law makes the Corporate the de-facto government.
gov_sona_command_desc: Son'a Command, the de-facto interstellar government of the exiles of Ba'ku, was never meant to be a governing body. It is the slow and gradual evolution of the organisation put in place by the first exiles, meant to coordinate the early military, mining and industrial concerns of the Son'a. Eventually, this quasi-military-corporate body gained more and more authority over matters of finance, resource allocation, and colonial affairs, until it is now the ruling agency of the exiles.
gov_sov_dynasty_desc: Known on hundreds of worlds, the Sovereign Dynasty of Krios Prime has been the ruling body on Krios Prime since the civil war between the Kriosians and the Valtese. Protected by the Sovereign Guard, it holds absolute sway over it's subjects.
gov_stagnant_democracy_desc:
A noble attempt to merge together the governments of several cooperating species, the First Federation roots range back over 50,000 years. The original government character was an attempt to combine the ideals of a direct democracy, but it was complicated by multiple compromises that were meant to ensure every species had a say in the running of the Federation. In the millennia since then, as the Federation sunk into decline, seclusion and ennui, things have only complicated further.

The result today is a system heavy with rituals, customs, bureaucracy and procedure, with every action requiring approval from multiple local community forums and elective regional archons. The leader of the First Federation, the President, has only the powers of a figure head, while the very little actual power is fought over by the various committees. The Parliament of Parishes, that has a single volunteer representative from each region, is currently the most powerful body - but it has nearly 150 thousand members.
gov_surakian_administration_desc: Embodying the pure logic of Surak, this administration seeks to wage peace with as much tenacity as they would wage war.
gov_tal_patriarchy_desc: The Talarian political structure is rigidly patriarchal, in which females in the society can never outrank a male. War and competition also play an important role in Talarian culture, and warrior-like behavior is strongly encouraged in males.
gov_the_order_desc: Dedicated to the task of restoring the Vau N'Akat to it former greatness, the order will stop at nothing to undue to damages to Solum and bring about the glory of its people.
gov_ufp_desc: Multiplanetary Unions represent a number of different worlds and species under a single state, itself comprised of semi-autonomous sectors.
gov_ufp_sector_desc: Federation sectors enjoy broad autonomy to conduct their private affairs, but they are still subject to the principles of the Federation Charter.
gov_val_senate_desc: The ruins of the ancient temple of Akadar, once the seat of power for the joint Valtese and Kriosian empire, is still the symbol of power for the Valtese. Their senate is modelled after the ancient ways.
gov_vedek_assembly_desc: Nominally a democracy governed by an elected chamber of ministers, the long-lasting Bajoran Second Republic is in fact headed by several political bodies that each share a sphere of influence and control. Each body is headed by prominent members of a certain D'jarra caste. In the last few centuries, the main foci of power lay within the Vedek Assembly, high-ranking priests that are led by the Kai, the highest religious authority in the Republic.
gov_virtual_democracy_desc: While all Bynars are linked to each other via their connection with the Central Computer, they are not a single organism. Each Bynar pair still has its own distinct personality, and Bynar's government is in fact a highly active direct democracy facilitated via the instantaneous connection with Central Computer. Nearly every decision voted on by Bynar's from across the Domains, and furious arguments can sometime last for several heated nanoseconds.
gov_wadi_surchid_desc: The Wadi enjoy playing games of all kinds, and were highly competitive in them. They possess an advanced game known as Chula, in which people are transported into a reality where they are the game pieces. Even the Wadi government is controlled by games. The winner of their most prestigious game tournament became the ruler of the Wadi, while lesser tournaments determined the leaders of their clans and other groups.
ideological_wars_desc:
We must further our own interests, even when they run contrary to the interests of others.

Claiming others' systems is only allowed during defensive wars or against Merged Awareness empires.

Unlocks the 'Ideology' Casus Belli on all empires with differing Ethics.
internal_security_1_desc: Low funding and focus on preventing external threats.
internal_security_2_desc: Moderate funding and focus on preventing external threats.
internal_security_3_desc: Heavy surveillance and checks for external threats that impact on the liberties of the population.
leader_trait_doctor_2_desc: This leader is considered a senior medical practitioner.
leader_trait_doctor_3_desc: This leader is has reached the top of the medical profession.
leader_trait_doctor_desc: This leader is qualified to practice medicine.
leader_trait_engineer_3_desc: Known as a miracle worker by some, this highly skilled engineer can command your flagships.
leader_trait_nurse_desc: This leader is qualified to practice nursing.
obsidian_espionage_4_desc: The elite inner circle of the Obsidian Order, very few know of the existence, even fewer leave the circle.
policy_anti_borg_1_desc: We may enact a maximum of 1 Anti-Borg Edict while this policy is in effect.
policy_anti_borg_2_desc: We may enact a maximum of 2 Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect, and the £ Influence cost of each is slightly reduced.
policy_anti_borg_3_desc: We may enact all 3 Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect, and the £ Influence cost of each is significantly reduced.
policy_anti_borg_none_desc: We will not have access to any Anti-Borg Edicts while this policy is in effect.
policy_anti_borg_policy_desc: This policy dictates our empire's investment into anti-Borg tactics and technologies. Greater investment comes at the cost of our standard research efforts.
policy_citizenship_full_desc: Allow foreigners within our border to get access to full citizenship rights.
policy_citizenship_none_desc: Restrict foreigners to limited rights only.
policy_counter_espionage_policy_desc: Espionage is an unavoidable aspect of interstellar relations. Resources can be expended to limit the effectiveness of hostile actions, but the social cost can be high.
policy_cross_breeding_policy_desc: This policy defines our empires stance on alien species cross breeding. Imposing restrictions on our population leads to a small amount of pop unhappiness.
policy_de_assimilation_policy_desc: Borg drones are dangerous in isolation and deadly in groups. The approaches taken to de-assimilate drones back into individuals are limited primarily by the technology level of those performing the de-assimilation.
policy_edu_accelerated_biology_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Society Research points, each.
policy_edu_accelerated_engineering_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Engineering Research points, each.
policy_edu_accelerated_physics_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 3 £ Physics Research points, each.
policy_edu_balanced_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Physics Research, £ Society Research and £ Engineering Research points, each.
policy_edu_military_desc: Every £ Student will produce additional £ Trained Officers and defense armies.
policy_edu_private_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Comércio due to a privatised education.
policy_edu_propoganda_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 planet stability point, each.
policy_edu_religious_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional 1 £ Unity points, each.
policy_edu_social_desc: Every £ Student will produce an additional +1% Recursos de £ Empregos.
policy_education_policy_desc: This policy dictates our general policy on education, and whether it is freely accessible by the general population, or not. Changing this policy setting will adjust the resource outputs of our schools and universities across the empire, but will have no impact on our dedicated laboratories and their research projects.
policy_espionage_policy_desc: Espionage is an unavoidable aspect of interstellar relations. Resources can be expended to increase the effectiveness of our efforts.
policy_espionage_policy_dominion_desc: Dominion Security, supported by the Founders is in place to ensure the security and everlasting might of the Dominion.
policy_espionage_policy_obsidian_desc: The Obsidian Order is an organisation to both respect and fear across the galaxy. Resources can be funnelled into the agency to boost their effectiveness.
policy_espionage_policy_tal_shiar_desc: The Tal Shiar is an organisation to both respect and fear across the galaxy. Resources can be funnelled into the agency to boost their effectiveness.
policy_espionage_policy_ufp_desc: Starfleet Intelligence protect Starfleets interests both internally and externally. Their effectiveness is governed by how much funding they receive.
policy_eugenics_allowed_desc: The practice of genetic modification is allowed within our empire.
policy_eugenics_outlawed_desc: The practice of genetic modification is forbidden within our borders.
policy_eugenics_policy_desc: This policy defines our stance on the medical practice of genetic modification.
policy_external_leaders_great_houses_des: Allow the Great Houses to provide external leaders
policy_external_leaders_no_desc: We may not engage and hire external leaders.
policy_external_leaders_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of externally hired leaders.
policy_external_leaders_yes_desc: We may engage and hire external leaders.
policy_gender_rights_policy_desc: Gender rights refer to the state of ease of access to resources and opportunities according to gender, including economic participation and decision-making such as voting.
policy_health_clones_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to provide every colony with a full supply of clones ready to maintain our empire. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional +5% £ Pop Assembly Speed.
policy_health_drugs_desc: Calming pharmaceuticals are issued to most of the populace, resulting in increased stability on each planet with a £ Healthcare building.
policy_health_growth_desc: The focus of our healthcare system is to increase the welfare of our offsprings and to promote the growth of our population. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional +5% £ Pop Growth.
policy_health_infrastructure_desc: Healthcare is focused on modernising all equipment with autonomous functions, reducing the overall burden on repair and replacement. This increases available £ Amenities by 2.
policy_health_policy_desc: This policy dictates how our galactic medical facilities can be accessed by the general population. Changing this policy setting will change the resource outputs of our clinics and hospitals across the empire.
policy_health_private_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 2 £ Comércio due to the privatised nature.
policy_health_social_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 2 £ Unity.
policy_health_testing_desc: The healthcare system utilises forced testing of new medicines and drugs on patients, without their consent. Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 10 £ Society Research at the expense of stability.
policy_health_university_desc: Every £ Healthcare Job will produce an additional 5 £ Society Research.
policy_internal_security_policy_desc: Our internal security services work hard to prevent outside threats from harming our state.
policy_mercenary_use_no_desc: We cannot engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_mercenary_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of mercenary groups to help us in our wars.
policy_mercenary_use_yes_desc: We may engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_traffic_control_disabled_desc: Disable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_enabled_desc: Enable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_policy_desc: This Policy determines if are Starbases automatically come with a Traffic Control Facility.
policy_twoyearlyevent_policy_desc: The running of your empire's biannual espionage, trade or infiltration policy can get taxing. Decide whether you wish to see them with this toggle.
policy_ufp_crew_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ trained officers to the Federation.
policy_ufp_cultural_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ consumer goods to the Federation.
policy_ufp_economic_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ trade value to the Federation.
policy_ufp_humanitarian_desc: Every member world will increase £ unity generation in the Federation.
policy_ufp_industrial_desc: Every member world will provide additional £ alloys and £ minerals to the Federation.
policy_ufp_policy_desc: This policy dictates the United Federation of Planets policy on member worlds, and what they should focus on providing to the Federation as a whole. Changing this policy setting will adjust the resource outputs of our member worlds across the empire.
policy_ufp_tech_desc: Every member world will provide a +2.5% increase to research.
policy_ufp_war_desc: Every member world will provide additional naval capacity to the Federation.
policy_war_posture_emergency_powers_desc: Grant Emergency Powers to the governing body to handle the war time situation.
policy_war_posture_normal_desc: No stance is taking during war.
policy_war_posture_policy_desc: This Policy defines our empires stance during war time.
policy_war_posture_seek_peace_desc: We will aim to seak a peaceful resolution.
policy_war_posture_total_mobilisation_de: Full mobilisation of our war time efforts.
policy_xeno_rights_policy_desc: This policy defines how we should treat foreigners within our borders and whether they should receive full citizenship rights.
sth_liberation_wars_desc: We fight to liberate those who cannot fight for themselves.
tal_shiar_espionage_1_desc: Minimal funding for the Tal Shiar.
tal_shiar_espionage_2_desc: Moderate funding for the Tal Shiar.
tal_shiar_espionage_3_desc: Max funding for the Tal Shiar.
tal_shiar_espionage_zhatvash_desc: The agency within the Romulan Empire, that even the Tal Shiar agents fear.
total_wars_desc:
There will be no peace, no negotiation, and no mercy. Military power is the only determinant of our borders.

Gain access to war goals that allow conquest of systems and planets without prior claims or occupation.

Conflict of this type always applies to both sides of a war!
tr_adaptability_borg_1_delayed: Backup processing nodes ensure that viable adaptation strategies are never erroneously discarded, significantly increasing combat efficiency.
tr_adaptability_borg_2_delayed: Predictive data analysis integrated within existing adaptive algorithms will increase the applicability of derived solutions, preventing a wider range of threats.
tr_adaptability_borg_3_delayed: Improvements to data acquisition and analysis greatly increases the rate at which we adapt to enemy weapons configurations.
tr_adaptability_borg_4_delayed: Specialised force field emitters are required for 87.6% of all countermeasures against species native to Fluidic Space.
tr_adaptability_borg_5_delayed: Defeat is irrelevant. Upon destruction of any of our units the plexus sends out collected information for analysis at the central processing node.
tr_adaptability_borg_5_desc: 25% chance to gain +100 Ruler XP when a Borg ship is destroyed. 33% chance that a Borg Cube or Tactical Cube will spawn a Borg Sphere on destruction.
tr_assimilation_1_delayed: The chaotic era where organic empires dictated the course of galactic history is over. The Collective will now take its rightful place, guiding the lesser species towards Omega.
tr_assimilation_2_delayed: With countless billions of perspectives waiting to be directed at a given quandry, there is no field of study the Collective cannot eventually master.
tr_assimilation_3_delayed: Rapid-deployment nanotube talons significantly increase the rate and volume of nanoprobes delivered to assimilation targets, greatly reducing resistance against tactical drone operations.
tr_assimilation_4_delayed: Against highly resistant species, the battle capability of tactical drones must be elevated at least one standard deviation above previous baseline. Additional combat instruments added to servo-armatures will achieve this goal.
tr_assimilation_5_delayed: All tactical drones will be adapted to use spectrum-cycling ocular implants supported by precision targeting lasers. Identification and apprehension of priority assimilation targets will increase by a significant margin.
tr_assimilation_finish_desc:
Ascension Perks Unlocked: +1
Drone Boarding Chance: +25%
tr_automation_2_delayed: Advances in fabrication processes have yielded a +5% decrease in the time it takes to construct buildings on planets within the empire, as well as +5% increase in population assembly and +75% additional alloy production from Factory Workers.
tr_automation_3_delayed: Our scientists have discovered new algorithms to find the best research to study.
tr_automation_3_desc: Unlocks advanced technology that makes research automation possible.
tr_automation_4_delayed: Multiple efficiencies are made to the operation of Starbase. Including decreasing upkeep by -5% and increasing module and building build speed by +10% as well as increases the Starbase upgrade speed by 5%.
tr_automation_5_delayed: Advances in AI have enabled our ships to increase how long they can last and their ability to recover by connecting to all parts of the ship. This way, the energy distribution increased a lot, and the ability to build emergency forcefields in case of a hull break also increased. This raised its survivability significantly.
tr_automation_5_desc: Unlocks the technology to build a new automation component on the engineering module slots on your ships.
tr_cardassian_2_1_delayed: Our armies fight to demonstrate the might of Cardassian and to annex those deemed to be best suited to serving Cardassia.
tr_cardassian_2_2_delayed: The rights of the Cardassian people take precedence over all else and our rivals see this and fear it, our confiscation protocols ensure that it is always Cardassia first.
tr_cardassian_2_3_delayed: Life under the whip of a Cardassian guard is harsh, we Cardassians have learnt long ago how to get the most from our labor force.
tr_cardassian_2_4_delayed: The natural order of things puts the Cardassian at the top, with the directive of the Obsidian Order to guide our citizen on the correct path.
tr_cardassian_2_5_delayed: The defence of Cardassian sovereign systems will always be a priority and the new orbital defence structures will protect us from any threat and the ability to build these faster will keep our Union safer.
tr_cardassian_2_5_desc: Orbital defence stations are built a 3rd faster than before.
tr_cardassian_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases happiness across the Cardassian Union.
tr_connectivity_borg_1_delayed: Utilising the cortical nodes of thousands of drones, it is possible for the Collective to simultaneously design and construct planetary-scale facilities in parallel, maximising process efficiency.
tr_connectivity_borg_2_delayed: Assimilated advancements in graviton manipulation technology will enable us to further expand the Unicomplex superstructure, in order to house several billion additional drones.
tr_connectivity_borg_3_delayed: Drone shortages at critical facilities will impede territorial and technological development. Drones must be relocated in an efficient manner to those locations as quickly as possible.
tr_connectivity_borg_4_delayed: Once equipped with sufficient interlink redundancies, it is possible to establish a network of supercomplexes, distributing the production and processing capabilities of the Unicomplex across multiple unimatrices.
tr_connectivity_borg_5_delayed: Extension of territorial reach beyond the range of the Unicomplex increases the risk of mass incursions by resisting species. Recommend assimilation of existing technological platforms as auxiliary Unicomplex expansions.
tr_connectivity_borg_5_desc: Enables the construction of Subcomplexes on ruined ancient megastructures, galactic forum stations, and incomplete scientific arrays.
tr_cunning_1_delayed: Abandoning logic allows for our true emotions to take hold. Those who are our friends will remain so, but those who are our enemies will feel the full might of the Romulan Star Empire.
tr_cunning_2_delayed: Having legions of informants across the empire ensures that weakness and unrest will be easily quashed, as well as providing surveillance networks for our defence forces.
tr_cunning_3_delayed: Using alien races to supplement our legions is an effective way of bolstering our military. To ensure loyalty, we offer the highest honour - with service comes citizenship.
tr_cunning_4_delayed: An imperial bureaucracy spanning the Star Empire allows for every Romulan to know their place.
tr_cunning_4_desc: Our £ Unity output is increased by +5%. Continuing Committee Senators now also increase £ Capacidade Administrativa by 5.
tr_cunning_5_delayed: Our greatest legacy since leaving Vulcan has been the creation of a Star Empire that spans many systems, using our superior cunning to conquer and absorb new worlds into our mighty empire.
tr_diplomacy_insider_trading_delayed: Bringing foreign peoples to our worlds to experience our culture and showcase their own is one way to improve relations between two alien cultures. By creating areas, designed to give foreigners a fresh start on our worlds, we can increase the likelihood foreigners will find our worlds hospitable.
tr_discovery_faith_in_science_desc: Velocidade de Inspeção is increased by +35% and Chance de Separação de Nave Científica is increased by +50%.
tr_discovery_finish_desc: Increases our Velocidade de Pesquisa by +5%.
tr_diversity_1_delayed: The individuality of each member of our society is something to be championed, not quashed. Each individual brings new strengths to the table, new ways of looking at problems, and new ways of finding solutions. By ensuring that we offer everyone a voice, we can spread our ideals far and wide.
tr_diversity_2_delayed: Delegating command authority to local captains can increase the capabilities of our far-reaching survey vessels by allowing a degree of autonomy and trust to our captains. They are the initial explorers, ambassadors, and envoys of our society, tasked with embracing the galaxy beyond our frontiers.
tr_diversity_3_delayed: Learning about diversity is not the same as experiencing it. Field trips to alien cultures and foreign worlds are an important part of the diversity process.
tr_diversity_4_delayed:
The public has finally come to regard science as more than simply a tool for the development of hi-tech toys and goods, but see it as it truly is - the ultimate way to answer the challenges this galaxy throws at us.

There is no question in this universe so big that it cannot be answered by science. Now that our leaders embrace the scientific method, it will clearly lead to better informed decisions.
tr_diversity_5_delayed: When we dare to cross the threshold that separates organic with artificial intelligence, something miraculous happens.
tr_dominance_1_delayed: Our psychic connection allows our race of many to speak with the voice of one. One powerful voice that demands the subjection of all those who are inferior.
tr_dominance_2_delayed: With a large production of biomass, our vessels and starbases can be refitted and upgraded to our highest standards.
tr_dominance_3_delayed: Our biological prowess surpasses all our rivals, careful observation is more than enough to demonstrate our superiority.
tr_dominance_4_delayed: Our biological dominance is power enough to ensure that all inferior species tremble at our feet.
tr_dominance_5_delayed: Perfecting a race such as ours is no easy feat, but our science how allowed our species to further its goal towards biological perfection.
tr_domination_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of the Domination tradition tree allows us to Subjugate and Vassalize other empires and decreases the Custo de Remoção de Bloqueador by -33%.
tr_domination_colonial_viceroys_desc: The Limite de Nível de Governador is increased by 2.
tr_dominion_2_1_delayed: Our Jem'Hadar forces are unmatched in their loyalty and the ferocity in which they do battle, driving their will for battle only increases their skill on the battlefield.
tr_dominion_2_2_delayed: We claim Dominion over all around us and we enforce this with our powerful fleets who make sure that the Founders power is respected and brings fear.

Country naval cap add: +50

tr_dominion_2_4_delayed: Not all battles are won on the battlefield, some are won via intelligence and espionage. The Founders can be anyone and see anything.

tr_eugenics_1_delayed: The Genetics lab is home to all discoveries centred on the genome and a home to the brightest in this field.
tr_eugenics_2_delayed: The fastest route to death is to stand still and let it come to you, tailoring our bodies to meet the future will ensure our survival.
tr_eugenics_3_delayed: Genetic superiority comes from knowing that our core makeup is better than our competition and mastering our biology will drive our species forwards.
tr_eugenics_4_delayed: The technique to change the characteristics of a plant, animal or micro-organism by transferring a piece of DNA from one organism to a different organism.
tr_eugenics_5_delayed: Eugenics is a philosophy or practice of extremely selective breeding, which breed very specific traits into or out of a group of organisms taken to the next step via genetic modification.
tr_federation_1_delayed: This bureau is charged with the industrialisation of developing worlds to ensure Federation technology is brought to their worlds, and to bring them up to the same level of development as the rest of the Federation.
tr_federation_1_desc: Allows special Member World Research Programmes to be undertaken at the Federation science station.
tr_federation_2_1_delayed: The Cochrane Institute offers a home for the best and brightest in warp theory and space travel.
tr_federation_2_2_delayed: Breakthroughs in sensor imaging and holo technology have allowed for advancements in the field of Stellar Cartography, with the right focus this wiil improve our abilities to map the stars.
tr_federation_2_3_delayed: The UFP works best when its citizens collaborate and bring the best of the species together with the best of another, this sense of all being in it together results in a sense of unity across the Federation.
tr_federation_2_3_desc: Country produces +1% more unity. /nStarbase capacity increased by 5 /n Time needed to demote unemployed population is redced by 20%
tr_federation_2_4_delayed: Federation citizens feel most at ease when they know they are safe, the security bureaus help maintain the illusion of peace and safely across Federation worlds.
tr_federation_2_5_delayed: Exploring new cultures can you to civilisations old and new. Using the latest in camo technology allows us to get closer to our subjects of interest and observe them in ever closer detail.
tr_federation_2_5_desc: Unlocks more research produced from Observation Missions and access to the Watchtower Class Megastructure and Osler-Science Hull at Tier 9./nStarbase capacity increased by 5
tr_federation_2_adopt_desc: Adopting the first stage of this tradition increases the Federation's first contact processes.
tr_federation_2_delayed: The Federation Merchant Association is a service organisation charged with the duty of moving cargo and goods vital to the survival and expansion of the Federation. tr_federation_2_desc:

Unlocks new tradition: Federation Charter
tr_federation_3_delayed: Arising from the need to understand different species' biological functions, Starfleet Medical has physicians and researchers from all over the Federation, each putting their own strengths towards improving medical health across the Federation.
tr_federation_3_desc: Efficient healthcare reduces [GetCrimeDeviancy] by -10 and improves Estabilidade by +5.
tr_federation_4_delayed: Cultural exchange between potential Federation members and our people allows for greater understanding between parties.
tr_federation_4_desc: Adopting this tradition reduces the cost of bringing new civilisations into the Federation to 75% of its original cost.
tr_federation_5_delayed: Every species has different etiquette and procedures that require flexibility from all parties involved. Setting up adaptive protocols for member worlds to follow allows for improved political sway from their delegates.
